3220-4279-5332--216.easyPrerequisites:
The undying creature doesn't have a +1/+1 counter on it.

3220-4279-5332--216.description:
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing the undying creature.
When the creature dies, Carmen, Golgari Germination and the undying creature's undying ability trigger.
Resolve the Carmen trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and put a +1/+1 counter on Carmen.
Resolve the Golgari Germination ability, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Resolve the undying trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on any creature and drawing a card.
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Carmen triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and put a +1/+1 counter on Carmen 
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on the undying creature and drawing a card.
Repeat.

Activate any number of creatures by tapping them, adding at least {2}.

Resolve Rally of Wings, untapping all creatures you control and giving creatures you control that have flying +2/+2 until end of turn
Repeat from step 2.

Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing a creature

Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on them.
Repeat.

728-2158-3249-6248--52.easyPrerequisites: Grimgrin does not have summoning sickness.
728-2158-3249-6248--52.description:
Activate Grimgrin's ability from Esika by tapping Grimgrin, adding one mana.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the creature castable for one mana, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
When that creature dies, Phenomenon Investigators triggers, creating a creature token or a token that adds mana.
If you created a creature token, repeat steps 1 and 2 to sacrifice that token and add an additional mana.
If you created a token that adds mana, instead activate that token to add mana.
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, allowing you to cast the sacrificed creature from your graveyard this turn.
Cast that creature from your graveyard by paying one mana.
Repeat.

2178-5173-6095-6495.easyPrerequisites:
Zul Ashur, Lich Lord does not have summoning sickness.
Thornbite Staff attached to Zul Ashur.
2178-5173-6095-6495.description:
Activate Zul Ashur by tapping it, targeting Shambling Ghast.
Cast Shambling Ghast from your graveyard by paying {B}.
Activate Evereth by sacrificing Shambling Ghast.
When Shambing Ghast dies, it and Zul Ashur trigger.
Resolve the Shambling Ghast trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Zul Ashur trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the Evereth ability.
Activate the Treasure token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat.
2178-5173-6095-6495.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

728-6972-7725.description:
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing Selfless Police Captain.
When Selfless Police Captain dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability.
Repeat.

5641-7096-7306.easyPrerequisites: You've had a land enter this turn.
5641-7096-7306.description:
Cast Basking Broodscale by paying {1}{G}.
When Basking Broodscale enters with a +1/+1 counter on it due to Bioengineered Future, it triggers, creating a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token that'll also enter with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
When the Eldrazi Spawn dies, The Ooze triggers, creating a Mutagen token.
Activate the Mutagen by paying {1}, tapping and sacrificing it, putting a +1/+1 counter on Basking Broodscale.
Basking Broodscale triggers, creating a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token that'll enter with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat from step 3.

2510-3532-5078-7750.easyPrerequisites: There is a removable counter on a creature you control.

Cast Sensei's Divining Top by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
Medusa triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing an Egg token.
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Phantom Train and causing it to become a creature until end of turn
Repeat from step 2.

Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 1.

628-5256-7219.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing The Reaper.
When The Reaper dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When The Reaper enters the battlefield, it triggers, putting a -1/-1 counter on it.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability
Repeat.

575-5256-7084.notablePrerequisites: You control two other nontoken creatures that have base power 1 or greater.
575-5256-7084.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing the first additional creature.
When the creature dies, Yedora and Beifong's Bounty Hunters trigger.
Resolve the Beifong's Bounty Hunters trigger, earthbending a land.
Resolve the Yedora trigger, returning the first creature from your graveyard to the battlefield face-down as a Forest.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing the second creature.
When the second creature dies, Yedora and Beifong's Bounty Hunters trigger.
Resolve the Yedora trigger, returning the second creature from your graveyard to the battlefield face-down as a Forest.
Resolve the Beifong's Bounty Hunters trigger, earthbending the first creature.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Activate the first and second creature by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing the first creature.
When the creature dies, Yedora and Beifong's Bounty Hunters trigger.
Resolve the Beifong's Bounty Hunters trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Yedora trigger, doing nothing.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing the first creature.
When the creature dies, Yedora and Beifong's Bounty Hunters trigger.
Resolve the Yedora trigger, returning the first creature from your graveyard to the battlefield face-down as a Forest land.
Resolve the Beifong's Bounty Hunters trigger, earthbending the second creature.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing the second creature.
When the creature dies, Yedora and Beifong's Bounty Hunters trigger.
Resolve the Beifong's Bounty Hunters trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Yedora trigger, doing nothing.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Repeat from step 6.

719-4508-6847.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to cause an artifact to enter the battlefield under your control.
719-4508-6847.description:

Weftstalker Ardent triggers, dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
Malcolm triggers, as Weftstalker Ardent is a Pirate due to Xenograft, creating a Treasure token for each opponent dealt damage this way.
When the Treasure(s) enter, Weftstalker Ardent triggers that many times.
Resolve the first Weftstalker Ardent trigger, dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
Repeat from step 3.

1912-2060-5140-6774.description:
Activate Kenrith by paying {G}, putting two +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler.
Activate Crystalline Crawler by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {G}.
Repeat.

You may place additional counters on Crystalline Crawler to get infinite mana, and then use that mana to activate Kenrith's abilities.
Once you have infinite mana, you may spend it on Kenrith's other abilities.

397-5670-6578.notes: Whether Sephiroth, Fabled SOLDIER or Sephiroth, One-Winged Angel is on the battlefield, the combo will function, either by using Sephiroth, Fabled SOLDIER's ability or the ability from Sephiroth, One-Winged Angel's emblem.

Activate Words of Wind by paying {1}.
Cast an artifact by paying {0}.

Activate Words of Wind by paying {1}.
Cast Mana Crypt by paying {0}.
Jhoira triggers, causing each player to return a permanent they control from the battlefield to their hand due to Words of Wind, with you returning the artifact cast in step 3 to your hand.

1306-1690-2538-5901.notes: You can use a historic creature to get infinite ETB and LTB triggers. If you do not use a creature, this combo will not produce those results.

Resolve the copy of Ghostly Flicker, blinking Mana Crypt and Strionic Resonator.

856-3967-4321-5632.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one Food.
856-3967-4321-5632.description:

Cauldron Familiar and Chalk Outline trigger.

Resolve the Su-Chi Cave Guard trigger, adding eight {C}.

Resolve the Sarcatog ability, giving it +1/+1 until end of turn.

Activate Saffi by sacrificing it, targeting Jackdaw Savior.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Jackdaw Savior.
When Jackdaw Savior dies, it and Saffi trigger.
Resolve the Jackdaw Savior trigger, returning Saffi from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Saffi trigger, returning Jackdaw Savior from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Repeat.

1287-1887-6318.easyPrerequisites: You have either {4}{U}{U} or eight {E} available.

When Aethertide Whale enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to get twelve {E}.
Activate Aethertide Whale by paying {E}{E}{E}{E}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.

2608-4499-5457.notablePrerequisites: Selvala does not have summoning sickness. You control at least three creatures with different powers.

222-308-3967-4871.notablePrerequisites:

When the creatures die, Pitiless Plunderer triggers twice, creating two Treasure artifact tokens.
Resolve the Yahenni abilities, giving it indestructible until end of turn.

Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling.
When the Saproling dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure artifact token.
Resolve the Slimefoot and Squee ability, returning it and another creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee enter the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat.

Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a Servo, adding {C}{C}.

Once you have infinite mana, you may instead use Retrofitter Foundry's first ability to untap it and get infinite untapped Servo tokens.

Cast Ugin's Conjurant from the top of your library by paying {0}.
Ugin's Conjurant enters the battlefield and dies as a state-based action due to having zero toughness.
Mortuary triggers, putting Ugin's Conjurant on top of your library from your graveyard.
Repeat.

2136-4688-4840.notablePrerequisites: Orthion does not have summoning sickness.
2136-4688-4840.description:
Activate Orthion's second ability by paying {6}{R}{R}{R} and tapping it, creating five token copies of Myr Battlesphere.
When the Myr Battlesphere tokens enter the battlefield, they trigger, creating twenty 1/1 Myr artifact creature tokens.
At the beginning of your end step, Orthion triggers, causing you to sacrfiice the Myr Battlesphere tokens.
At the beginning of your next upkeep, Epic Struggle triggers, causing you to win the game.

423-1313-1437-1671.notablePrerequisites: Myojin of Cryptic Dreams has at least two indestructible counters on it.
423-1313-1437-1671.description:
Cast Arboreal Grazer by paying {G}.
Holding priority, activate Myojin by removing an indestructible counter from it, copying the Arboreal Grazer spell three times.
Resolve the first Arboreal Grazer copy.
The Arboreal Grazer token enters the battlefield, putting SImic Growth Chamber from your hand onto the battlefield.
Simic Growth Chamber enters the battlefield, triggering itself and Evolution Sage.
Resolve the Simic Growth Chamber trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Evolution Sage trigger, putting an indestructible counter on Myojin.
Repeat from step 3 two additional times.
Repeat from step 2.

953-1371-2001-4475.notablePrerequisites: Your life total is equal to or higher than 2^X, where X is the number of players in the game.
953-1371-2001-4475.description:
Cast Enter the Infinite by paying {8}{U}{U}{U}{U}.
Hive Mind triggers, causing each opponent to copy Enter the Infinite.
Allow all copies of Enter the Infinite to resolve, causing each player to draw a number of cards equal to the number of cards in their library, put a card from their hand on top of their library, and causing each player to have no maximum hand size until their next turn.
Cast Shahrazad by paying WW.
Hive Mind triggers, causing each opponent to copy Shahrazad.
Resolve the first copy of Shahrazad, starting a sub-game.
Each player loses the subgame due to not being able to draw seven cards from their library.
Finish resolving Shahrazad, causing each player who lost the subgame to lose half their life total rounded up.
Repeat steps 6-8 resolving all copies of Shahrazad.
Move to your end step, triggering Wound Reflection, causing each opponent to lose life equal to the life they lost this turn.

1261-1719.notablePrerequisites: Vizier of Tumbling Sands does not have summoning sickness.
1261-1719.description:
Activate Vizier of Tumbling Sands by tapping it, untap Time Vault.
Activate Time Vault by tapping it, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

614-1987-2427-3941.description:
Activate Coveted Jewel by tapping it, adding {U}{U}{U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {U}, targeting Coveted Jewel and Nucklavee, blinking them.
When Nucklavee enters the battlefield, return Ghostly Flicker to you hand.
When Coveted Jewel enters the battlefield, draw three cards.
